biography.value:
Description

The legendary dragon of the fire and ash has returned but with greater power. This dragon is difficult to kill and is consider a powerhouse.

Defense

AC 41, touch 11, flat-footed 32 (+30 natural, +9 dex, -8 size)

hp 1015 [1334] (29d12+319)

mp 257

Fort +26, Ref +25, Will +26

Absorb Fire; DR 20/magic;

Immune Ability Drain, Berserk, Blind, Charmed, Confuse, Cowering, Death, Diseased, Doom, Energy Drain, Entangled, Exhausted, Fatigued, Fear, Frightened, Frog, Immobilized, Imperil, Mini, Nauseated, Panicked, Paralysis, Petrify, Sap, Shaken, Silence, Sleep, Slow, Staggered, Stop, Stunned, Zombie;

SR 34;

Weakness Ice and Water

Offense

Speed 60 ft., fly 250 (Clumsy)

Melee Bite +35 (4d8+27 plus 3d6 fire damage), 2 claws +35 (3d8+18 plus 2d6 fire damage), 2 Wings +33 (2d8+9 plus 2d6 fire damage), tail slap +33 (3d8+27 plus 2d6 fire damage)

Space 30 ft.; Reach 20 ft.

Special Attacks Breath Weapon (70-ft. cone, 24d10 fire damage, Reflex DC 34 half, usable every 1d4 rounds), Crush (Large creatures, DC 34, 4d8+27), Flare Star, Level 4 Flare, Red Fang, Southern Cross, Tail Sweep (Medium creatures, DC 34, 3d8+27)

Burst Mode Life Force

Spells Known (FC CL 29th, concentration +39)

0th (DC 20) - Bleed, Detect Magic, Mending, Ignite, Torchlight

1st (DC 21) - Detonate, Fire, Flame Breath

2nd (DC 22) - Burning Arc, Detonate II, Elemental Resistance, Fiery Shuriken, Fire II, Flaming Sphere

3rd (DC 23) - Detonate III, Fira, Fire III

4th (DC 24) - Burning Blood, Fire IV, Volcanic Storm, Wall of Fire

5th (DC 25) - Burn, Firaga, Fire Snake

6th (DC 26) - Blazing Winds, Contagious Flame, Flamestrike, Flare, Meltdown, Shadowfire Ray

7th (DC 27) - Burn II

8th (DC 28) - Fire Storm, Flare II, Wall of Lava

9th (DC 29) - Meteor, Ultima

Statistics

Str 46, Dex 28, Con 30, Int 24, Wis 26, Cha 30

Base Atk +29; CMB +55; CMD 74 (78 vs. trip)

Feats Cleave, Devastating Strike, Diehard, Furious Focus, Empower Spell, Endurance, Great Cleave, Improved Initiative, Improved Vital Strike, Iron Will, Multiattack, Power Attack, Quicken Spell, Toughness, Vital Strike

Skills Appraise +40, Bluff +43, Diplomacy +43, Fly +26, Intimidate +43, Knowledge (arcana) +40, Knowledge (history) +40, Knowledge (local) +40, Perception +41, Sense Motive +41, Spellcraft +40, Stealth +26

Languages Common, Draconic, Ignan

description.value: Unlike most burst modes this one starts at the beginning of the fight, This Burst Mode lets Red Dragon burst with a fiery form, making it more difficult to hurt him and empowers him. For a number of rounds equal to 1 + 1 round for every four HD, Red Dragon gains damage reduction by 90% vs magical/physical attacks, gains a fire aura of 120-ft.-radius doing 3d6 points of fire damage per round and hasteja. This limit break requires only an immediate action to activate. After the end of this burst mode Red Dragon dies.

description.value: Once every 1d2+1 rounds as a standard action, Red Dragon will summon a 30 ft.-radius firestorm on the selective target completely burning all those who fail their Reflex save (DC 34) or take 15d8 points of fire damage. Every target will have to make two successful Reflex saves (DC 34) or continue burning taking 1d12 fire damage per round with their serious burning status effect. If someone makes one save they reduce the serious burning status therefore they only need to make one successful save the following round taking the burning status effect damage instead until they make it. Blue mages may learn this ability as an 8th level spell (Knowledge: Arcana DC 31). During Life Force, increase radius to 90 ft.
